issue.title: [IssueOps] Foundry deployment: gpt-4.1 PTU for agents (prod)
issue.body:
### Foundry resource

aif-cooleng-prod-eus2

### Model name

gpt-4.1

### Model version

2025-04-14

### Model format (publisher)

OpenAI

### Deployment type (SKU)

GlobalProvisionedManaged

### Capacity

100

### Deployment name

gpt-4.1-agents

### Version upgrade option

NoAutoUpgrade

### Intended agentic use

Production backing model for the AKS agent runner (agentic-task-request, aks-foundry-agent backend) and the incident-summary agent. Predictable latency is required during incident response, so provisioned throughput is requested.

### Consuming repositories or services

CoolEngOrg/issueops (agent runner), CoolEngOrg/incident-bot

### Chargeback cost center

CC-3000-PLATFORM

### Review date

2027-03-31

### Acknowledgements

- [X] Only data classified Internal or lower will be sent to this deployment unless it is approved for Confidential data
- [X] I understand provisioned (PTU) deployments are billed hourly whether or not they are used

## ✅ Foundry model deployment created | Field | Value | | ----- | ----- | | Resource | `aif-cooleng-prod-eus2` (prod, eastus2) | | Deployment | `gpt-4.1-agents` | | Model | `gpt-4.1` `2025-04-14` (OpenAI) | | SKU / capacity | GlobalProvisionedManaged · 100 PTU | | Provisioning state | `Succeeded` | | Endpoint | `https://aif-cooleng-prod-eus2.openai.azure.com/` | | Quota (`OpenAI.GlobalProvisionedManaged`) | 250 used of 500 before this change | | Review by | 2027-03-31 | ### Using the deployment Callers authenticate with Microsoft Entra ID (keyless). Grant the caller's managed identity or service principal **Cognitive Services OpenAI User** on the resource, then call the deployment: ```bash TOKEN=$(az account get-access-token --resource https://cognitiveservices.azure.com --query accessToken -o tsv) curl -sS https://aif-cooleng-prod-eus2.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/gpt-4.1-agents/chat/completions?api-version=2024-10-21 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}],"max_tokens":16}' ``` For **Foundry Agent Service** agents, set `MODEL_DEPLOYMENT_NAME=gpt-4.1-agents` and use the project endpoint of the Foundry project connected to `aif-cooleng-prod-eus2`. For the IssueOps AKS agent runner, ask platform-ai to add `gpt-4.1-agents` to `allowed_deployments`.
